harbor_adapter.notes: Registry dataset: all 100 EvoEval_difficult problems. evoeval-codegen ports EvoEval's API harness (prompt, greedy decoding, retry loop, sanitizer) to Harbor for parity. A separate verifier container runs the original checker. parity_costs is null because the per-token price of the parity endpoint is not known; Harbor-side parity usage was 79,227 input and 1,243,544 output tokens over 3 runs (the original side sends the same requests).
